master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production complete vehicle game master of mustard yellow all-terrain 6x6 cargo truck, carrying six tonnes of pallets of aid sacks secured under netting. Equipment: folded crane boom and stowed recovery spades. Thick dried mud, weathered materials, rich natural texture, fine mechanical detail and readable dark contours in the approved Swamp Scout premium semi-realistic painted illustration style. Reference 1 defines style; reference 2 defines strict perpendicular camera and close rear tandem ONLY; reference 3 defines matching tire/rim. Facing RIGHT. Exactly 3 visible near-side ROAD tires, all 1.43 m diameter mud-terrain tires with deep chunky mud lugs and open voids; one steer axle at right and a CLOSE rear tandem at left supporting the entire heavy load. Total length 8.1 m = 5.664 tire diameters, under 16.8 m. Entire cargo attached securely to truck, all equipment stowed within canvas. Horizontal chassis/deck/load; level hubs and tire bottoms. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Real conventional short-bonnet heavy-truck cab; distinct bonnet, radiator housing, blunt bumper, headlamp, clean seams and round front fender following tire clearance. Small rectangular mirror at A-pillar on short rigid brackets. No melted fused wedge panels or floating mirrors. Every road tire fully visible. No visible front grille face, no visible bed end face. Wide 2048 x 1024 PNG intended, at least 1500 pixels wide; whole vehicle with clear margins. True transparent background and internal gaps, soft even daylight. No ground shadow glow halo scenery text logos watermark.

wheel.method: Reuse matching generated mud-terrain tire design; normalize and composite identically on master
wheel.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one production game road-wheel sprite for Bogmaster 2, chrome silver all-terrain 6x6 cargo truck. Reference image is illustration style only: approved Swamp Scout. One 1.35 m mud-terrain tire with deep chunky dark charcoal mud lugs and open voids, thick dried mud in recesses, weathered silver steel heavy-truck rim, centered bolted hub. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration, readable dark contours, fine mechanical detail and rich natural textures. Face-on perfect circle with hub exactly centered, equal clear margins on all four sides. Square PNG canvas intended 1536 x 1536 pixels (native 1254 x 1254 acceptable). Soft even ambient daylight suitable for spinning. True transparent background including all outside margins, no ground or drop shadow, no glow, no checkerboard, no text logos watermark, no axle or body. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires
